purpose: T14 B4 estimator-level comparison of RLCD-like sampled proper-reward policy-gradient objectives against exact proper-loss baselines on the same frozen R1 cohort used by T11. This compares estimator objectives, not model architectures, and makes no action-utility, profitability, trading, or promotion claim. The paired categorical Brier policy gradient is one research candidate, not the definition of RLCD.

upstream.scope_note: T11 established that no baseline beat train-only base_rate significantly. T14 reuses the identical cohort, folds, instrument partition, seeds, feature order, and metric definitions; only the estimator objective set differs.

cohort.model_input: Same boundary as T11: only the 11 feature values in declared order reach an estimator. asset_id, venue, decision_ns, record ID, label, fold, group and regime metadata never enter a predictor.

fold_policy.source: upstream R1 pit_validator_core via the unmodified financial_pit_v1 walk_forward, identical to T11
fold_policy.fit_rows: Retained train rows restricted to primary instruments; no calendar stress exclusion, identical to T11
fold_policy.selection: dev NLL minimum over the full frozen candidate set, ties by candidate name; test is never used for model, seed, coverage, or threshold selection
fold_policy.calibration: calibration metrics on primary instruments only; no fitted calibration transform
fold_policy.test_readout: each frozen arm is evaluated on test exactly once; all arms' test metrics are reported, but selection consumed only dev
fold_policy.empty_phase_rule: Any empty phase after instrument restriction is a hard failure; no fold may be skipped.

instrument_holdout.hash_sort: SHA-256 of the full key, ascending lexicographic digest then key
instrument_holdout.fit_rule: Only primary enters fitting, development, and calibration. Holdout groups are untouched until test readout; per-group test metrics are the stability readout.
instrument_holdout.venue_holdout: unsatisfiable in Binance-only V1; report as limitation, never silently imply venue generalization.

calendar_stress_windows.source: upstream R1 C8 declared list, identical to T11
calendar_stress_windows.role_in_t14: pre-registered descriptive test strata only; no row is removed from train/dev/calibration and no metric from a stress stratum may drive selection
calendar_stress_windows.regime_masks: Point-in-time regime masks remain a T12 concern; T14 reports instrument-group and calendar-stratum stability only.

estimator_arms.model_class: linear sigmoid on train-only standardized features; identical model class, initialization (all weights and bias exactly zero), minibatch schedule (size 16, seed-derived permutation shared across all objectives for the same seed), step budget, learning rate, and L2 for every fitted arm

rlcd_like_sampled.implementation: financial_rlcd_estimators_v1.fit_linear_pg (new numpy estimator-level port of scripts/calibrated_objectives.py paired proper-reward surrogate)

paired_brier_pg.draws: independent Bernoulli(p) draws with replacement per row per step
paired_brier_pg.baseline: detached conditional baseline over the other M-1 draws only; zero baseline is valid but not used
paired_brier_pg.expected_gradient: unbiased estimator of grad ||p - q||^2; data-free Monte Carlo bias check frozen below
paired_brier_pg.device: CPU numpy only; the MPS refusal of paired_brier_pg in train_pipeline_decisions.py does not apply because no torch/MPS path is used

correctness_pg.reward: hit-only 1[A = Y] with conditional baseline p[Y]; expected reward is linear in p and pushes probability toward the majority outcome
correctness_pg.role: documented biased negative control (per docs/RLCD_EXPERIMENT.md); never an RLCD candidate

rlcd_like_sampled.sampling_seed_rule: sampling_seed = training_seed * 1000003 + 17; permutation stream is default_rng(training_seed) identical to the exact-loss arms
rlcd_like_sampled.budget_rule: same step count, batch rule and per-seed permutation as the exact-loss arms; sampled arms additionally consume M reward draws per row-step

metrics.definitions: identical to T11: nll = mean clipped cross-entropy at 1e-15; brier = mean((p-y)^2); ece = 10 fixed bins of p against observed frequency

selective_risk.rule: top ceil(c * n) rows by confidence, ties by row order; a rank rule, not a fitted threshold
selective_risk.report: nll, brier, accuracy, ece and covered count per coverage per arm per phase-evaluated set

metrics.stability: per-instrument-group test metrics for every arm plus descriptive per-stress-window test metrics; no aggregate-only reporting
metrics.reward_decomposition: hit_component = 2*mean(p_y); agreement_component = mean(p^2+(1-p)^2); expected_reward = hit - agreement; exact_brier alongside, per fitted arm on train, so no aggregate reward can hide a component failure
metrics.estimator_variance: per-seed metric spread per objective, plus a gradient-variance diagnostic: 64 independent PG gradient realizations at the fitted parameters on the full primary train set, mean per-row componentwise variance reported next to the exact-Brier gradient norm
metrics.bias_check: data-free Monte Carlo check that the paired surrogate gradient matches its analytic conditional expectation within 5 standard errors on a frozen grid p in {0.1,0.3,0.5,0.7,0.9}, y in {0,1}, M=32, 2000 replicates, seed 1729; failure aborts the run receipt
metrics.interval: paired candidate-minus-base_rate 95% percentile bootstrap over whole instrument groups, shared resampled indices, seed 1729, 1000 replicates; reported for the dev-selected candidate and separately for every fitted arm (descriptive); no row-iid bootstrap
metrics.costs: estimator compute cost only: per-arm wall-clock fit seconds and the frozen M=32 sampling multiplier versus exact losses; monetary utility, PnL, and execution costs are out of scope at the estimator level (T12/T13 cover replay/risk)

authorization.approval_note: This is a T14 protocol/preflight artifact. It does not override project review gates or authorize fitting. A separate authorization receipt bound to this protocol's sha256 must flip fit authorization.

change_rule: Any change to upstream hashes, instrument groups, stress role, fold use, arm budgets, seed list, sampling rule, metric definitions, coverage levels, or interval unit creates a new protocol version; no in-place repair.
